messages:
anita r: Quick sync — operational pattern for SI co-sell handoffs when leads come from cloud marketplace or HW partners. We keep dropping the baton. Need a short step-by-step: what fields we set in SFDC, who pings the SI, AE notification, and rules for exclusivity vs. concurrent touches. Any proposals?

rob s: +1. I think we need a minimal playbook: intake tag -> partner pre-qual -> AE assign -> SI engagement window -> handback rules. Keep it <6 steps. :simple_smile: 48h SLA for initial SI ack?

maya g: I like 48h for a first ack. Also suggest a clear SFDC flag so ops can run reports. Minimal field list below (can be a custom Lead record type or just fields):
```
Lead.Source = Marketplace
Lead.Referrer = <partner_id_or_hw_sku>
Lead.Partner_Priority = high/med/low
Lead.SI_Assigned = partner_sales_rep_email
Lead.SI_Engage_By = YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ
Opportunity.Stage = SI_Engage
```
rob s: +1 to those fields. Also add Deal_Registration_ID if HW partner requires it.

samir k: For automation: when Partner_Priority = high AND SI_Assigned is set, partners-bot should post a short summary to #sales + create a lightweight task for the AE (eg create meeting, share intro template). We can wire that through Zapier or a simple lambda.

lina p: Also need rules of engagement doc that covers: who owns initial customer contact, cadence for joint intro, exclusivity window, and compensation/crediting. Proposal:
- SI has 7 business days to confirm active engagement (intro + first meeting).
- If SI confirms, mark Opportunity.Stage = SI_Engage and AE moves to co-sell mode (both assigned).
- If no confirm after 7 days, AE reclaims lead.
- Tiered escalation: >$250k escalate to partner lead; >$500k require EM or AE manager sign-off.

anita r: That sounds reasonable. We also need a short marketplace-specific addendum: some marketplace referrals need product trials or listing sync before SI jumps in. For HW partners, pre-qualification includes inventory/availability check.

rob s: Can we standardize two email templates: 1) intro to customer (joint), 2) follow-up if SI no-show (automated nudge). Lina can own templates?

lina p: I can draft templates. I'll keep them short and include a checkbox list for SI to confirm (intro done, demo scheduled, POC scope).

samir k: One more automation thought — map these states to a machine-readable label so our analytics can show conversion by partner type. Eg `partner_handshake:pending|engaged|timed_out`. That makes rollups trivial.

maya g: Agreed. We should also add a small field for "marketplace_listing_synced" to capture whether partner listing metadata and entitlements are verified. Helps for HW SKUs.

partners-bot: Created page <https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Partners/SI+Co-Sell+Operational+Pattern> and posted checklist. :spiral_notepad:

anita r: Awesome — next steps: 1) Lina drafts templates and ROE doc (due EOD Thu), 2) Samir prototypes partners-bot post + status labels (POC by next Wed), 3) Maya/Rob to update SFDC field list and coordinate ops to add fields (sync with revenue ops). I'll schedule a 30m sync for Monday to finalize.

rob s: Thanks — I'll add Deal_Registration_ID to the list and ping revops. :thumbsup:

lina p: On it, will share first draft in thread.

samir k: Will spin up a small lambda POC and share a demo gif.

maya g: I'll open the SFDC ticket and tag @revops.

anita r: Great. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here. Otherwise we'll roll this as the new default for marketplace/hw partner referrals. :rocket:
